from: WHAT YOU SHOULD SEE TODAY, AND IT IS A PROBLEM: the disclaimer is MISSING from the Credit Invoice. The shop does have one - the same shop's ordinary invoice prints a long paragraph beginning "Any warranties on the parts and accessories sold hereby are made by the manufacturer" just above the signature lines - but none of it appears on the credit note. (1) If that is exactly what you see - the signature lines present, no disclaimer paragraph anywhere - mark the case FAILED and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails DIFFERENTLY, for example the signature lines are missing too, that is a new problem - please report it. (3) If the disclaimer IS printed on the credit note, the fix has shipped - tell the QA lead.
to: WHICH CREDIT YOU OPEN DECIDES THIS, so open the right one. On a credit raised FROM AN INVOICE - its status table carries an "INVOICE NUMBER" - the disclaimer IS printed in full, just above the signature lines. On an account-level store credit (one made with the "Issue Credit" button on the customer's "Invoices" tab, which has no invoice number on it) the disclaimer does NOT appear at all. This case is about a credit raised from an invoice. (1) If the disclaimer and the three signature lines are both there, mark the case PASSED. (2) If either is missing, mark it FAILED and say which. (3) Separately, if you happen to open an account-level store credit and find no disclaimer on it, do not fail this case for that - tell the QA lead, it is already known.
